title: Keep new large evidence on G: and avoid repeated raw copies
ownerRow: | D202 | Coordinator routes new large verification and archive outputs to owned G: storage, with one verified canonical copy and explicit maps for identical artifacts. Existing evidence and frozen provider inputs remain unchanged. | C: has about 1.54 GiB free; repeated full captures make a single integration packet about 552 MiB. Capacity must not interrupt the remaining QA or lose evidence. | Delete history, move frozen inputs, change user-wide caches, introduce junctions, or continue duplicating full artifacts. All are declined; unique evidence and exact verification remain required. | [Decision and limits](decision-202.md); [task-owned inventory](task-storage-readiness-20261121-01/REPORT.md). Future outputs require explicit owned-path checks and exact hash/membership maps. All technical gates remain. |
qa: Carry D202 into the final catalogue. Preserve every original packet and failed attempt. New large outputs may use G:/ggq/delivery-evidence/2026-11-17-five-intents with small hash-bound Q pointers. Require verified byte-identical aliases, full unique evidence, exact source/archive checks and all existing review/QA/CI/merge gates. This does not complete any engineering or owner acceptance criterion.
resume: D202 selects new large receipts/candidates/downloads on G: with explicit path confinement and Q pointers. Preserve all existing C: evidence, frozen provider specs and pending provider output paths. Future integration evidence should stream hashes or compare Git blobs/modes and keep one canonical raw artifact plus alias map, rather than repeated full captures. No cleanup, relocation, junction, product or gate change is authorized by this decision. Through-D201 reader remains immutable; final refresh must include D202.
